roleContext.jobDescription: A mutual lender servicing about 60,000 mortgage accounts is recruiting a team leader for its servicing operation in Halifax. The team leader runs a team of administrators who handle payment changes, redemption statements and arrears correspondence, holds a recognised mortgage qualification, manages the month-end arrears processing deadline, watches the quality-check results and keeps procedures current when policy or regulation changes. Month-end is the busiest point of the cycle: arrears letters must be issued within the regulator's timescales, and the team leader decides which exceptions go to the collections manager and which are cleared in the team.

requirements.text: Leads a team of servicing administrators handling payment changes, redemptions and arrears letters.
Holds a recognised mortgage qualification such as CeMAP.
Manages month-end arrears processing to deadline and makes escalation decisions under time pressure.
Monitors quality-check results and runs refresher coaching where errors recur.
Updates servicing procedures after regulatory or policy changes.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Team Leader, Mortgage Servicing Operations

## Experience

- Servicing team leader at Calderbrook Building Society, October 2021 to present, leading nine administrators who process payment changes, redemption statements and arrears letters for residential mortgage accounts.
- Ran the daily work-allocation meeting and moved cases between queues to keep redemption statements inside the two-day service standard during the spring remortgage peak.
- Reviewed the team's monthly quality-check results and ran refresher sessions on redemption calculations whenever the same error appeared three times in a month.
- Prepared the month-end arrears letter run in the servicing system, checked the exception report for accounts with vulnerability markers or disputed balances, and passed those exceptions to the collections manager for decision.
- Updated the payment-holiday procedure notes after the 2022 policy change and walked the team through the revised steps at the Monday huddle.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised monthly quality-check summary for the team, giving sample sizes, error categories, the three recurring redemption-calculation errors and the dates of the refresher sessions that followed.
